title: How to Write Effective Peer Review Comments
skills: write specific, constructive peer review comments
distinguish useful feedback from vague praise or criticism
identify strengths and revision opportunities in a draft
use evidence from a text to support revision suggestions
alignment_note: Teaches students how to provide clear, specific, and constructive peer review comments that help writers revise effectively. Supports collaborative writing, revision, evidence-based feedback, audience awareness, and responsible participation in the writing process across high school English courses.
